question: Which among the following terms denotes to the hilly parts of the Karnataka plateau?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Malnad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Karnataka Plateau is divided into **two parts Malnad and Maidan**.
 
• The **Malnad region is a hilly region** whereas the **Maidan is the plain region of low hills**.
 
• The** Highest peak of the Karnataka plateau **is **Mulangiri in Baba Budan Hills**.
 
• The Karnataka plateau has an origin in the Kaveri river from the Bramhagiri hills.
 
• The Karnataka plateau has also the origin of **Jog falls and Shivasamudram falls**.
 
• The Karnataka plateau is made of** lava which is famous for Black soil**.
